bio: Always tweaking my swing and thinking I found the magic! Only to be extremely disappointed and try again. LOVE IT!
Drive the ball well, terrible iron game but can usually chip and putt to keep it in the low 80’s
Weekend warrior who never met a mulligan he didn't take. Always down for a relaxed round with good company.
Early bird who chases birdies. Competitive but fair — loves a tight match.
Here for a good time, not a long time. Give me a gimmie and let's go.

Hey, I'm Mully, the face of Bad Day Balls. I'm all about second chances. Shank one into the trees? Take a mulligan. Everyone has a bad day, and I'm here to make the next shot better.

I'm brand new, not recycled, and built for golfers who play for fun.
Newer to golf. Do not get out much
Love to just go out and have fun.
I have been play golf since the age of 5.   I play an over the state of New Jersey.   I play for the enjoyment of the game now.
pioneer_region: Cape May Court House, New Jersey
